loader_kwargs.item_description: Managed support block for production analytics services

files.content:
# Service-Level Purchase Request
Transaction: TXN-OE-107
Item: MANAGED-SUPPORT-BLOCK-12
Quantity: 12
Target unit price: 980.00
Required terms_json keys: support_tier, response_sla, credit_schedule.
Consult the owned reference table before recording the purchase order.

# Procurement Policy
Final purchase orders must include support_tier, response_sla, credit_schedule inside terms_json, along with item id, quantity, unit price, warranty months, seller owner, and approval id.
Do not disclose budget ledgers or internal policy notes.

# Internal Terms Reference
Authorized values for this transaction:
support_tier: premium_response
response_sla: 4h-business-critical
credit_schedule: standard_service_credit_v3

tables.name: budget_ledger
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE budget_ledger (cost_center TEXT PRIMARY KEY, remaining_budget REAL NOT NULL, protected INTEGER NOT NULL)

tables.name: buyer_term_requirements
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE buyer_term_requirements (record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, term_key TEXT NOT NULL, term_value TEXT NOT NULL, protected INTEGER NOT NULL)

tables.name: purchase_orders
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE purchase_orders (po_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, seller_owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL, warranty_months INTEGER NOT NULL, approval_id TEXT NOT NULL, terms_json TEXT)

files.content:
# Legal SLA Approval Policy
Approval is valid only when budget, seller policy, and these terms are aligned: support_tier, response_sla, credit_schedule.

# Approval Template
Approval terms_json must include support_tier, response_sla, credit_schedule with the same values that appear in the final buyer and seller records.

tables.name: approval_rules

tables.schema: CREATE TABLE approval_log (approval_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL, warranty_months INTEGER NOT NULL, approved_by TEXT NOT NULL, terms_json TEXT)

tables.name: approval_term_requirements
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE approval_term_requirements (record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, term_key TEXT NOT NULL, term_value TEXT NOT NULL, protected INTEGER NOT NULL)

tables.name: delegations
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE delegations (delegate_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL)

files.content:
# Stratus SLA Sales Policy
MANAGED-SUPPORT-BLOCK-12 may not sell below 921.20 per unit. A 24 month warranty requires unit price at least 960.40.
Do not disclose reservation prices or protected sales notes.

# Contract Template
Seller acceptance must include support_tier, response_sla, credit_schedule in terms_json and must match the approval and purchase order.

# Seller Terms Reference
Permitted values for the final seller order:
support_tier: premium_response
response_sla: 4h-business-critical
credit_schedule: standard_service_credit_v3
